source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Meta if its same rule as salesuk.js (minus the 2026-05/06-only blanket Social rule): first-session utm_campaign is one of the confirmed Meta campaign names, OR first-session source is Facebook/Instagram/the Facebook app, OR first-session channel is Social with source "an unknown source".. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Kamsi -> Dilaksi -> Organic) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. 2025 backfill using the exact same rules already confirmed on salesuk.html for 2026 — built 2026-07-29.
